errors.text: The stated conditions are tensile-test conditions, not the processing conditions required to produce phase-selective recrystallization; the essential cold-rolling and annealing schedule is omitted.
The quantitative outcome is transferred from a compositionally different Ni30Co30Cr10Fe10Al18W2 EHEA without evidence that it applies to the Al0.7CoCrFeNi starting alloy.
The proposed mechanism does not directly explain how dislocation pile-ups and stress concentrations at internal boundaries are relieved or how interfacial cracking is suppressed.
